deviations.what: The original's onRadioButtonSelected switches the CSSGrid gridAutoFlow per selectedIndex imperatively (0 Column, 1 ColumnDense, 2 Row, 3 RowDense). Rebuilt on the client with no round-trip: the RadioButtonGroup gets a two-way bound selectedIndex (an attribute the original does not carry - its controller reads the index off the event) seeded 0, and gridAutoFlow carries the same switch as an expression binding instead of the literal Column. The select attribute is therefore dropped; before this rework it was wired to an RB_SELECT backend event this class never dispatched (a dead wire, pattern-lint dead-event-wire).

The 'Reveal Grid' ToggleButton loses its press attribute. The original calls RevealGrid.toggle('grid1', view) from sap/ui/layout/sample/GridAutoFlow/RevealGrid/RevealGrid - a helper module that ships inside the sample folder, not in any UI5 library: it walks the grid's DOM and overlays absolutely positioned outline elements over every grid cell. There is no control, property or whitelisted control method that expresses it, and the module itself is not loadable in an abap2UI5 app, so the button stays in the view (structurally 1:1) but does nothing. Previously the press fired a REVEAL backend event no branch handled, which looked like behaviour and was none. The sample's actual subject - gridAutoFlow - is fully reproduced; the reveal overlay is a debugging aid around it.
grid:CSSGrid with gridAutoFlow + 10 VBox demo boxes, four carrying GridItemLayoutData row/column spans, 1:1.

The sample's own css/main.css is archived and injected since 2026-08-21. All ten grid tiles carry class="demoBox" and the rules behind it (.sapMFlexBox.demoBox rounded blue box, .demoBox .sapMText white) were missing entirely, so the tiles rendered as bare text instead of the blue rounded boxes the sample is a picture of - the same gap apps 122/124/133 had, and the sibling ports 346/347/271 already inject this very stylesheet. css/main.css now sits in ui5/sap.ui.layout/GridAutoFlow/css/. That did NOT close the AGENTS section 4 archive gap, as this sidecar claimed until 2026-08-23: the manifest also lists RevealGrid/RevealGrid.js - the controller's only dependency - and it was absent while RevealGrid.css was there. It is archived since 2026-08-23, taken from the two sibling sap.ui.layout samples that carry the same module byte-identically (GridResponsiveness, GridResponsiveColumnLayout), the network being out of reach here. scripts/check-archive.mjs now gates the whole class of gap. It reaches the view through an added core:HTML style leaf, which the original view does not declare.
